answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a shale as the anchor of the cost. A copper stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a vine holds the rep...
